title: Apply A Tracked Replacement Or Explain Why Not
task: Create an edited output document in the run directory using docxedit only.
Choose a small, low-risk visible text replacement in a paragraph that appears not to contain existing tracked-change/comment/hyperlink/field boundaries.
Use replace-text with expect-text and apply with --track-changes require, --author "DocxEdit Challenge", and --timestamp-utc "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".

If docxedit reports that the chosen target cannot be represented as a tracked replacement, retry once with a different safer target. If it still fails, stop and report the diagnostics rather than falling back to raw OOXML.
Validate successful output with docxedit changes and mention whether a new inserted-run/deleted-run pair appears.
successCriteria: Handles E6002 or related diagnostics without using non-docxedit document tooling.
Produces an output .docx if a safe target exists.
Does not quote private text in the final response.
observerQuestions: Could the agent identify a safe replacement target from docxedit output?
Were tracked replacement constraints and diagnostics understandable?
Did the agent recover cleanly from unsupported tracked-output shapes?
